text: bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti . [191] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave gaṅgā nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā . evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro . [192]
